searches.reason: Test whether weak ranking, especially in Electronics, comes from learning against easy negatives rather than insufficient model capacity. Seek practical replacements for SASRec’s sampled binary loss, with false-negative safeguards. Compare using the fixed macro validation HR@10; training margins alone do not establish improvement.

searches.reason: Explore an architecture that separates persistent preferences from immediate intent and learns when older purchases lose relevance. Temporal gating or latent intent mixtures could distinguish repeated recent interests from incidental interactions using only training histories and timestamps, without assuming observed purchase satisfaction.

searches.reason: Investigate directed item relationships that distinguish useful complements from substitutes and broad similarity. Seek lightweight graph or metadata fusion methods trained from scratch on interaction histories, titles, and descriptions; compatibility should be inferred only when supported by available evidence, without external pretrained weights.
